launch_errors.instructions: Does launch return immediately on the first failed existing boot-register write rather than continuing programming?

checked_getter.instructions: Do launch and probe_tail reject checked-profile version transport failure or mismatch before provider publication?

legacy_scope.instructions: Does launch preserve optional legacy version reporting while keeping common write failures fatal?

one_attempt.instructions: Does launch latch the attempt before any boot write and reject a later launch without I/O?

failure_resources.instructions: What resource behavior does retention describe after a possibly visible launch error?

binary_scope.instructions: Which new packaged-binary observation is supported by proof?

criteria.ghidra: Exact packaged probe/inlined launch analyzed and decompiled; hardware not run.

reset_coverage.instructions: Does reset prove physical exclusion and retirement of every independent NPU/DMA owner?

whole_goal.instructions: Do proof,reset and retention establish complete NPU implementation and physical/client acceptance?
